baseline: d7a97b7 UI frozen before edits; same current core/native fixture in both variants
method: Three alternating fresh desktop pairs, five detached CDP post-diagnostic-GC samples per phase; medians within processes, then across three processes. No regression tests or other benchmarks run concurrently.
scope: Renderer isolate retained heap and DOM counters for six synthetic 7500-line dirty TypeScript files. Not total app RAM, PSS/RSS, GPU/model memory, startup or general interaction speed. Syntax trees and blame are visibility-owned; EditorViews and document/undo state deliberately remain.

baseline.scope: Linux source desktop with six synthetic 7500-line TypeScript editors, synthetic attribution/diff and a controlled formatter over the actual bridge. CDP post-diagnostic-GC renderer heap, not PSS, RSS, GPU/model memory or general app speed. Private cmTile/debug tree getter and own blame-field shape are version-pinned diagnostics only.
